Definition: Kadesh-Barnea, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Kadesh-barnea is where the wilderness generation turned back: the fathers were sent from there to see the land, the people came through the great and terrible wilderness to Kadesh-barnea. Caleb remembered that he was forty years old when Moses sent him from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Kadesh-barnea as the place where a whole generation said no to God, and the forty years that followed began there.
